title: 50m Mangusta Motor Yacht N1 For Sale for the First Time
description: The Mangusta motor yacht N1, which measures 49.95 meters, has recently hit the market! Represented by Ömer Balkan of Btwo Marine, N1...
html:
Photo courtesy of superyachttimes.com

The Mangusta motor yacht N1, which measures 49.95 meters, has recently hit the market! Represented by Ömer Balkan of Btwo Marine, N1 showcases a departure from the traditional Mangusta 165 models with its classic and timeless design characterized by rounded and curved shapes. Designed by Lobanov Design, with naval architecture by Overmarine Group, the yacht draws inspiration from 1930s sports cars, evident in its slender, dynamic lines and cleverly concealed 499 GT interior volume. To learn more about the exquisite Mangusta motor yacht N1, its unique features, and the extraordinary maritime experiences it offers, continue reading.

The 49.95-metre Mangusta motor yacht N1 has entered the market for the first time since her delivery in 2022 and is the sixth largest yacht built by the yard. She is represented by Ömer Balkan of Btwo Marine. The motor yacht for sale features rounded and curved shapes, creating a classic and timeless aesthetic, marking a change from previous Mangusta 165 models.

N1 features exterior design by Lobanov Design, with naval architecture by Overmarine Group. Drawing inspiration from 1930s sports cars N1’s slender, dynamic lines accentuate her elongated blow and low profile, cleverly concealing her 499 GT interior volume. Up to 10 guests are accommodated onboard, and N1 also provides accommodation for nine crew members including the captain

The yacht for sale boasts expansive side windows in her main saloon, seamlessly bridging the gap between the interior and exterior spaces, creating an immersive connection with the surrounding ocean for guests. Additionally, the main saloon features an overhead glazed strip that extends to the ceiling, infusing the room with an abundance of natural light. Furthermore, the two side windows open onto two fold-down balconies, providing breathtaking sea views and allowing radiant sunlight to flood and envelop the entire area.

N1’s master stateroom is inspired by the elegance of a New York penthouse and has been thoughtfully designed across two levels to offer maximum privacy to her owner. The streamlined side windows and the versatile entrance lounge create an open and inviting atmosphere, forming a private oasis furnished with comfortable sofas and coffee tables.

On the opposite side of the owner’s suite, a spacious table serves as an office desk. A partial wall separates the two levels, with the lower level featuring circular shapes and rounded windows that harmonise with the custom-made round bed, crafted to the owner’s specifications. The lower deck of the owner’s suite also houses an opulent onyx-clad bathroom and two generously sized dressing rooms. Ceiling-high glazed surfaces infuse the space with natural light, providing breathtaking views of the surrounding seascape.

The yacht N1 for sale boasts several unique features, with a particular highlight being her expansive exterior spaces. The main aft deck stands out, showcasing a generously sized outdoor dining table that sets the stage for idyllic alfresco dining experiences. The innovative beach club provides guests with an immersive connection to the surrounding environment, thanks to its sunpads and comfortable sofas.

For relaxation, guests can indulge in the infinity pool located on the foredeck. This pool seamlessly melds with the sea, creating a harmonious connection between the yacht and the vast expanse of the ocean.

The Mangusta yacht for sale has a GRP hull and superstructure. She is powered by quadruple MTU engines, which give her a cruising speed of 30 knots and a top speed of 34 knots. N1 will be at anchor at the upcoming Monaco Yacht Show 2023.
